scope: 3-RPS supervised indoor self-weight-only PoC; no cart, payload or person; three factory-finished new upper brackets and existing A1-A3 machining only; no separate stopper
coordinate_system: Lower centre origin; +X right, +Y front, +Z up; roll X, pitch Y

A1.load_path: eye -> diameter-6 pin -> PHS6 inner/outer race -> pocket/M6 -> bracket -> multiple fasteners -> 3030 slot
A1.local_equilibrium: r=e*t; F=F*u; M=r cross F. Eye, actuator and lower R must balance force AND eccentric couple; reactions unverified.

A2.load_path: eye -> diameter-6 pin -> PHS6 inner/outer race -> pocket/M6 -> bracket -> multiple fasteners -> 3030 slot
A2.local_equilibrium: r=e*t; F=F*u; M=r cross F. Eye, actuator and lower R must balance force AND eccentric couple; reactions unverified.

A3.load_path: eye -> diameter-6 pin -> PHS6 inner/outer race -> pocket/M6 -> bracket -> multiple fasteners -> 3030 slot
A3.local_equilibrium: r=e*t; F=F*u; M=r cross F. Eye, actuator and lower R must balance force AND eccentric couple; reactions unverified.

cases.pin_candidate: HCDGH6-35; S45C equivalent 40-45HRC, hardness is not a yield guarantee
cases.ring_load_path: E5 is axial retention only, not an extra primary actuator-load support
cases.model_limits: N, mm, MPa=N/mm^2. Cantilever pin surrogate; average single shear combined conservatively with outer-fibre bending, not a resolved contact stress field. Kt is not silently set to 1 for approval.

tolerance_screen.clearance_scope: Each eye source is a separate fixed nominal, NOT delivered eye tolerance; conditional bounds include both pin g6 limits only
required_bounds: minimum continuous shoulder length excluding fillets/thread transition

pin_transition.reason: HCDGH head relief and ring groove Kt, delivered yield strength, continuous contact length and E5 ring axial capacity unknown

eye_reaction.reason: Front eye bore bearing capacity, contact distribution and moment reaction unknown

lower_hinge_reaction.reason: Lower R bearing spacing/capacities and actuator bending/couple closure unknown

phs_contact.reason: Exact PHS6 manufacturer static/radial/axial and reversing contact capacities unknown; dynamic rating alone is insufficient

m6_reversal.reason: Actual engagement length, material, thread stripping, tension/shear interaction, preload and locking under reversal unknown

pocket_contact.reason: Housing-neck/pocket contact area, pressure distribution, capture under pull and local permissible bearing unknown

bracket_web.reason: Web section, local stress concentration, material guarantee and peak stress/deflection unknown

slot_attachment.reason: T-nut pullout/slip, bolt spacing/preload, friction, profile lip bearing and manufacturer slot capacities unknown

tolerance_stack.reason: Delivered hole/pin/shim/ball-width/machining limits and shoulder-thread transition positions unknown

three_axis_equilibrium.reason: All poses and eight simultaneous force-sign combinations need global force/moment and frame reaction closure

source_evidence_gaps: LM4075OE eye bore discrepancy and delivered eye dimensional tolerances
Current BOM TRUSCO 280-7599/PHS6 delivered static capacity and tolerances unverified; historical THK candidate is not current BOM
PHS6 housing outer diameter/width manufacturing tolerances
HCDGH6-35 head relief, guaranteed yield strength and supplied E5 ring axial capacity; eye width tolerance and worst-case stack fit unknown
TRUSCO stem/nipple 3D geometry and protrusion bounds unverified; all-azimuth assumed envelope cannot verify actual clearance
M6x12 retainer exact SKU, complete thread engagement, tolerances, blind-bottom clearance and flush head margin unverified
Delivered DNF3030 slot section and tolerances
Selected T-nut manufacturer drawing, tolerances and slot compatibility

fault_screen.note: 750 N is a conservative static review load in both signs, not verified pull rating or maximum fault force; 2000 N self-locking is not stall thrust.
